subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which fix sequence should own the remaining work for issue 93383: the open focused PRs, a maintainer-authored replacement, or split canonical issues for each subproblem?
rationale: The issue is valid but spans session fences, subagent delivery durability, typing lifecycle, and retained locks, and the current labels explicitly block new uncoordinated fix PRs while several candidate PRs remain open.

options.title: Sequence focused PRs
options.body: Use the existing focused PRs for silent message loss and equal-line fence false positives, then require a narrow follow-up for requester typing cleanup with live channel proof.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Pause the external candidates and replace them with one maintainer-owned branch that defines the session-state invariant and resolves the overlapping fixes together.

options.title: Split and close subproblems separately
options.body: Keep this issue as a tracking report only after creating narrower canonical issues for fence, delivery, typing, and lock-finalization ownership.

recommendation.title: Sequence focused PRs
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused PRs for silent message loss and equal-line fence false positives, then require a narrow follow-up for requester typing cleanup with live channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged partial fix that already narrowed one major slice of this exact issue and are the strongest current-history owner for the central embedded session-lock controller path.
